name: Advent Calendar Quickstart
description: Scaffolds a working Advent Calendar: content type, Year vocabulary, a term for the current year, one door node per day, and a View.
project_description: Advent Calendar Quickstart is a one-shot setup submodule for Advent Calendar. On install it ensures the Advent Calendar Door content type exists (installed as optional config), creates the Year taxonomy vocabulary and a term for the current year, and creates one door node per day (days 1 to 24) with randomised positions, each referencing the current-year term and a shipped candle image. It also installs a ready-made View (advent_calendar) that uses the Advent Calendar Views style. Door nodes are created unpublished so they can be published (manually or via a scheduling module) as each day arrives. Once it has run the submodule serves no further purpose and can be uninstalled; it can be reinstalled the following year to seed that year's entries.
